correctness.rationale: For every arc \((p,q)\), the internal worth contains \(a_{pq}\) times the unanimity game \(u_{\{p,q\}}\); that game's Shapley value is \(1/2\) at each endpoint. Linearity proves the all-incident-arcs formula. The exact three-cycle witness has coalition worths \(0,1,2,3\) by coalition size and Shapley value \(1\) for each player, whereas the displayed reciprocal-only term plus its external component gives \(0\).
